# Teck Leong Industries Pte Ltd — copper.asia (full catalogue)

> Singapore stockist of copper, brass, bronze and tungsten copper since 1933.
> Cutting to size, serving customers across Asia. B2B supplier — request a quote,
> no online shop.

## About

- Founded in 1933.
- Authorised distributor of NIBCO fittings.
- Serves customers across Asia from Singapore.

## Contact

- Ubi Office & Factory: 215, 217 & 219 Ubi Ave 4, Intrepid Warehouse Complex, Singapore 408810
- Tuas South Office & Factory: 1 Tuas South Street 8, Singapore 637107
- Tel: +65 6790 9777
- Fax: +65 6790 9555
- Email: sales@copper.asia
- Enquiry: https://copper.asia/cms/Enquiry
